description.value: Pho 37 is a multi-location Vietnamese restaurant chain that started in Steveston and expanded to Robson Street in Vancouver, serving freshly made pho, vermicelli bowls, and traditional Vietnamese appetizers. The brand has earned recognition including a Canadian Choice Award for Vietnamese Restaurant and Yelp Elites Top Places to Eat, and promotes MSG-free cooking with ingredients prepared daily in each location. Touring cyclists on Robson Street will find a full sit-down dining room with takeout and delivery options available.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 9m; stands (5 spaces) at 35m; stands (2 spaces) at 42m; stands (2 spaces) at 89m. Total: 11 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Robson St location at 1578 Robson St with phone (604) 354-2030, matching OSM exactly. Takeout is confirmed by 'Order To Go Pick up at our Restaurants or Get delivery by our partners'. Vegetarian options are confirmed by multiple menu items labeled 'Regular / Vegetarian' and tofu alternatives. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi information appears anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed open at the OSM address with a matching website. A useful stop for touring cyclists on Robson Street.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists vegetarian options including 'Spring Rolls (3) Regular / Vegetarian', 'Salad Roll (1) Shrimp / Tofu', 'Vegetables and Tofu Noodle', and vermicelli bowls with vegetarian choice
